summary: End-to-end verification of 5 new features: (1) drag-and-drop pole reordering with grip handles via @dnd-kit, (2) simplified JobDetail title bar with only Map/Export/Add Pole/Add Underground, (3) per-pole Sync Distances buttons, (4) Sync Dist buttons in ViewPole + EditPole headers, (5) JobMap Screenshot button using html2canvas, plus Excel export with per-pole Photos ZIP + View Map hyperlinks. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS - including XLSX content inspection confirming 'Photos ZIP'+'View Map' text and /api/poles/{id}/photos-zip + /jobs/{id}/map hyperlinks are embedded per pole. Frontend Playwright PASS - all data-testids resolve, title bar contains only the 4 expected buttons (no Photos ZIP/Map ZIP/Map Image/Sync Distances), 2 per-pole sync buttons render for OCALC (2 poles), per-pole sync POST returns 200, reorder opens DnD UI with 'Drag poles to reorder' instructions + 2 sortable items + 2 grip-vertical icons, ViewPole + EditPole headers each render [data-testid='sync-distances-btn'], JobMap renders [data-testid='screenshot-btn'] which on click downloads 'A050ABC_screenshot.png', and Export button downloads a valid 'A050ABC_20260612_002500.xlsx'.

Backend pytest TestExcelExportLinks::test_excel_downloads_xlsx: PK magic bytes verified, Content-Type xlsx

Backend pytest TestPolePhotosZipEndpoint: photos-zip endpoint returns 200 ZIP or 404 (no 500)
Frontend: Admin login -> /jobs list -> open OCALC (e5dc0bae-...) -> data-testid='job-detail' visible
Frontend: Title bar contains map-btn, export-btn, add-pole-btn, add-underground-btn only; Photos ZIP / Map ZIP / Map Image / Sync Distances buttons + label text are ALL absent from <header>
Frontend: 2 per-pole sync buttons render (one per OCALC pole) - [data-testid^='sync-pole-']
Frontend: Clicking per-pole sync triggers POST /api/poles/{id}/sync-distances -> 200
Frontend: Reorder button toggles DnD mode showing 'Drag poles to reorder' banner + 2 sortable items + 2 GripVertical icons (no chevron up/down arrows)

critical_code_review_comments: routes/poles.py PUT /poles/reorder still uses untyped List[dict] payload (line 313). Consider a Pydantic PoleReorderItem model for stronger validation; malformed payload silently no-ops with updated=0 - not blocking but degrades API contract clarity.

JobMap.jsx captureMapScreenshot uses html2canvas with useCORS:true and a 2s defer for tile rendering - works for the OCALC test job. For routes with a large viewport or slow tile sources the 2s wait might be insufficient; consider waiting for an explicit 'tile-loaded' event from Leaflet rather than a fixed timeout.
JobDetail.jsx is now 633 lines (above the 700-line recommended threshold once dnd-kit boilerplate is added). Consider extracting SortablePoleItem into its own file under /components.

routes/jobs.py builds the Map hyperlink as '{public_base}/jobs/{job_id}/map' (without /api) - correct because /jobs is a frontend route - but the 'View Map' label is identical for every pole, so users opening the XLSX will click the same link from any pole row. If the intent was per-pole map links (e.g., '/jobs/{job_id}/map?pole={pole_id}'), the current implementation is just a job-level link. Worth confirming product intent.

Backend sync-distances endpoint (poles.py L246) returns 200 with updated=False for unknown pole rather than 404 - acceptable but inconsistent with REST conventions; consider raising 404 when pole doesn't exist.
seed_data_creation: None - tests use the existing seed job e5dc0bae-96bb-4cef-8001-7baf4e41d80a (A050ABC, 2 poles). Reorder test was not saved (cancelled). Per-pole sync was triggered but only updates span1/span2 from GPS - idempotent.

Key data-testids: map-btn, export-btn, add-pole-btn, add-underground-btn (JobDetail title bar); sync-pole-{poleId} (per-pole sync); sync-distances-btn (ViewPole + EditPole); screenshot-btn (JobMap). Note: 'View Map' link is job-level (same URL for every pole row) - confirm with PM if per-pole anchor was intended. Drag-drop save uses PUT /api/poles/reorder (already covered by previous iteration's test_reorder_and_zips.py).
